content: Jesu ni Zakiyasi
Jesu sebeli oingena mu Jeliko mi kame ana kubita feela.
Cwale kame kuna kwikalanga omulume no litina lya Zakiyasi, neli omukulu no mutelisi ni kufuma.
Cwale sebeli osaela nji amone Jesu nji anyine, kono sebeli okwanggwa mulibaka no aanu no kupula ni kwibiba ku siyema saye.
Cwale sebeli oitukela balubala nuukatina ku sitondo no sikamole nji amumone, kakuli Jesu nakubita endila eyo.
Cwale Jesu aba ana kukeela ba sibaka eso, sebeli waliketa ku wilu ni kwamba kwa yonyene nji, “Zakiyasi otuluke muwanguwangu kakuli kame nifanena okwikala mu ndoo yowe balelo.”
Cwale Zakiyasi sebeli oleluba ni kutulukela banji ni ku mutambula mu kuwabelelwa onene.
Cwale aanu aba ana kumona ngeeso sebeli an̄un̄uta nji, “Kame anati okatenda ongenda no mulume osikutenda eibi!”

Cwale Zakiyasi sebeli oimana ni kwamba kwa Mbumu nji, “Komone, Mbumu, elicika no ufumu wange kame niba kwa sikusheba, nji kame nina byangula omunu esinu saye, kame nimuuseta etitikanyo no kukwana tinee.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, “Balelo okuyoyisiwa na kwiiyi muno mu ndoo, kakuli ni yonyene mwana a Abulahama.
Kakuli Omwana no munu neeyi muku saela ni kuyoyisa eso sinatauka.”
Aba ana kuyupa einu eyi, Jesu sebeli otwalelela okwaambela enguli. Kakuli kame ana kwikala beebi ni Jelusalema, mi kakuli kame ana ku yambuta nji omubuso wa Nyambe kame uli beebi oku monahala ababo.
Cwale Jesu ababo sebeli wamba nji, “Omulume no ku kutekeha sebeli ota ku naha oko no kuleba akatambula omubuso mi cwale sebeli ouka.
Sebeli oisana abika aye no kukwana likumi ni kwaaba etipondo likumi ni kwamba kwa onyene nji, ‘Mu fundote amali aa okutwala abo sanika ukele.’
Kono aanu aye naku mutimba mane sebeli atuma onumwana munyima yaye okaamba nji, ‘Ka tusingi wuyu mulume nji atubuse.’
Aba ana kuuka munyima no katambula omubuso sebeli olaela abika aye awo ana kuba amali nji aiye kwa yonyene nji alimuke eso anawana mukuulisa koo.
Ono weli sebeli oiya ba lubala lwaye ni kwamba nji, Molyange, epondo yowe naini wanene etipondo likumi beulu.’
Cwale sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, ‘Nutende wino, wene omubika no kuwaba! Kakuli nusepahala kwicana onene, mbu busu emilenen̄i no kukwana likumi.’
Omubika no wiili sebeli oiya ni kwamba nji, ‘Molyange, epondo yowe ina wanenebo etipondo titanu kame.’
Cwale sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, ‘Cwale mbu busu milenen̄i itanu.’
Cwale omubika munjili sebeli oiya ni kwamba nji, ‘Molyange, ino yokame epondo yowe eyo nina kupungelanga mu lwambi.
Kakuli kame nina kucilanga wene kakuli uli munu no kubambaba. Kame oshimba omo kausi beeka mane kame okutula omo kausi kuna.’

Cwale sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, ‘Kame sani kwatule kweyo itunda mu kanw kowe! Wene omubika no kububa! Kame ona kulimuka nji mene nili omunu no kubambaba mene nishimba omo kanisibeeka mane niku kutula omo kani sikukuna.
Cwale iikene aba wasikubeeka amali ange mu panga? Cwale bakwiya kwange kambe kame nina ishimbi ni n̄ambeko yayo.’
Cwale sebeli wamba kwawo ana kwimana naye kunyonga nji, ‘Mushimbe epondo kwa yonyene mi mwiibe woyo okwite etipondo likumi.’
Cwale sebeli aamba kwa yonyene nji, ‘Mbumu kame akwite etipondo likumi!’
‘Kame ni myambela nji, ‘Omunu yonje woyo okwite mbabiwi onene, kono kwa woyo oulwile simba neso akwite mba byanguliwa.
Kono kanyi kwiila yange awo ka sikusinga nji nabuse, mwalite kuno nikwaibaele balubala wange!”’
Jesu aba ana Kwingena mu Jelusalema mu Umbumu
Cwale Jesu aba ana kumana okwamba eyi, sebeli wekeza okuta ku Jelusalema.
Cwale aba ana kukeela ku nyonga no Betefage ni Betani ku lilundu elyo liisaniwa nji Olibeti, sebeli otuma aiyetwa aye ayiili balubala,
ni kwambela nji, “Mute mu mundi oli balubala lwenu, abasa mwingenemo mba muwana akana no mbongolo kanungilwe ako kaka sitiniwa kale ku munu. Mu kanungutule mi mukalite kuno.
Nji omunu kame sami ibangute nji, ‘Iikene aba muka fungutula,’ mu mwambele nji, ‘Ombumu kame aka saela.’”
Cwale awo ana kutumiwa sebeli ata nukawana akambongolo kanyi omo ana kwaambela Jesu.
Cwale alemine oku fungutula akambongolo, omunyako sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji. “Iikene aba mu fungutula akambongolo?”
Cwale sebeli aamba nji, “Ombumu kame aka saela,”
Cwale sebeli alita akambongolo kwa Jesu, ni kuyala eikumango yoo beulu no kambongolo ni kwikatabo Jesu.
Cwale yoenda, sebeli ayala eikumango yoo mu ndila.

Cwale aba ana kukeela abeebi ni Jelusalema, ba ndila ishetumuka ba liundu no Olibe, okupula no aiyetwa sebeli atateka okuwabelelwa ni kuyeema Nyambe ni liywi no kuneneba mullibaka no musebezi no kuneneba ana mono.
aamba nji, “Embuyoti ni yawoyo oiya mu litina lya Mbumu! Ekozo iikaleko mu wilu ni kanya mu liwilu.
Cwale Afalisi anjili mu kupula sebeli aamba nji, “Mwiyeti,” okalimele aiyetwa owe!”
Jesu sebeli otambula nji, “Kame ni myambela nji, aa nji aondoke, amawee mba kuwu.”
Jesu abana Lilela Jelusalema
Cwale aba ana kusheeteta abeebi ni mulenen̄i no Jelusalema sebeli oulilela,
ni kwamba nji, “Kambe na mukulimuka mu liywaa na balelo einu itenda ekozo! Kono cwale kame ishweekilwe ku miyo enu!
Kakuli amaywaa mbaiyi kwa wene abo eila yowe mbai kutinguluka ni lukwakwa no kwambeka ikuyatilele ku maneku onje.
Cwale kame sa kukwisete banji wene bamweya naanowe, mi katamba kusiya eliwee limweya beulu no likwayo mwa wene, kakuli kusilimuka enako ona poteliwa!”
Jesu Yota ku Ndoo ya Nyambe
Cwale Jesu sebeli oingena mu Ndoo ya Nyambe ni kutateka okucita awo ana kuulisangamo,
ni wamba kwa onyene nji, “Kame kun̄olilwe nji, ‘Endoo yange kame saitende eyi no tapelo.’ Kono aanyi namwifutula omo akushweeka ambuyi!”
Cwale Jesu nakwiyetanga mu Ndoo ya Nyambe amaaywaa onje. Apulisita akulu na n̄oli, ni manduna no sicaba sebeli alela okumwibaa,
kono kasi kuwana esinjili eso ana kufanena okutenda, kakuli aanu onje kame ana ku teetetanga ku maywi aye.
